title: A Inheritance for the Witness
author: Oscar Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
